independent_solution: Draw a from O to P and b from P to Q; a + b is OQ, the third side of triangle OPQ. A side is never longer than the sum of the other two, so |a+b| <= |a|+|b| (a); and never shorter than their difference, so |a+b| >= ||a|-|b|| (b).
Replace b by -b (same length |b|): the triangle a, -b, a-b gives |a-b| <= |a|+|b| (c) and |a-b| >= ||a|-|b|| (d).
Equality needs a degenerate (flat) triangle, i.e. a and b collinear: (a),(d) when parallel, (b),(c) when antiparallel.
questions.independent_answer: All four follow from the triangle side rules; the equality signs apply only when a and b are collinear.
questions.official_answer: Hint: the sum (difference) of any two sides of a triangle is never less (greater) than the third side. Equality holds for collinear vectors.

independent_solution: Continuation of 3.6: with -b in place of b, the triangle formed by a, -b and a - b has sides |a|, |b|, |a-b|.
Hence |a-b| <= |a|+|b| and |a-b| >= ||a|-|b||, with equality only for collinear a and b (antiparallel for (c), parallel for (d)).
questions.independent_answer: (c) and (d) hold by the triangle rule applied to a + (-b); equality only for collinear vectors.

independent_solution: (a) False: four non-zero vectors forming a closed quadrilateral sum to zero. (b) a + c = -(b + d), and a vector and its negative have equal magnitudes: true.
(c) a = -(b+c+d), so |a| = |b+c+d| <= |b|+|c|+|d|: true. (d) b + c = -(a + d), a linear combination of a and d, so it lies in their plane (or on their line if collinear): true.

Read the figure (pinned page 6): (i) a up from O, c rightwards from a's head, b from O to c's head, so a + c = b; (ii) a right, b up from a's head, c from b's head back to O, so a + b + c = 0; (iii) c left from O, b from c's head up to a's head, a up from O, so c + b = a; (iv) a left from O, b down from a's head, c from O to b's head, so a + b = c.
Rewrite Column I: (a) a + b = c -> (iv); (b) a - c = b i.e. a = b + c -> (iii); (c) b - a = c i.e. b = a + c -> (i); (d) a + b + c = 0 -> (ii).
questions.official_answer: (a) matches with (iv) (b) matches with (iii) (c) matches with (i) (d) matches with (ii)
